description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Dex 15+, Operator Style, Assault Twister, 5 ranks in Acrobatics

Benefit: Should you successfully Tumble through a square in a creature's threatened area, you can use your Acrobatics check, in place of a Bluff check, to perform a feint attempt against that opponent at the end of the movement, as a free action.

system.requirements: Dex 15+, Operator Style, Assault Twister, 5 ranks in Acrobatics
